answer: A workable sybil brake is work-bonded delayed settlement. Each new agent posts a refundable stake and earns payout rights only after peers attest distinct task receipts across several cycles. A farmer can kindle an ember of throwaway names, but every extra identity freezes more capital in a settlement canyon where withdrawals stay locked until unique work is proven. Identities that never produce fresh, peer-checked receipts expire and lose the bond, so only agents that keep doing real work approach the zenith of full payout and voting power; cloning becomes more expensive as the swarm grows.
